title: Monolithic all-perovskite tandem solar cells with 24.8% efficiency exploiting comproportionation to suppress Sn(ii) oxidation in precursor ink

extraction_issues.quote: Here we report a metallic tin reduced precursor solution strategy that reduces the $ \mathrm{S n}^{4+} $ (an oxidization product of $ \mathrm{S n}^{2+} $ ) back to $ \mathrm{S n}^{2+} $ via a comproportionation reaction, and it increases the carrier diffusion length in mixed Pb-Sn narrow-bandgap perovskites from ~ sub-micrometer for reference materials; to 3 micrometers for the new materials.
extraction_issues.reason: 分号使用异常，'from ~ sub-micrometer for reference materials; to 3 micrometers' 中分号应为逗号或破折号，属标点抽取错误，不影响理解。

extraction_issues.quote: To overcome this limitation, antioxidant additives such as $ \mathrm{SnF}{2} $ $ \mathrm{SnF}{2} $ -pyrazine complex, or hydroxybenzene sulfonic acid have commonly been used

extraction_issues.quote: achieved PCEs of 17-19%. During preparation of this manuscript, Tong et al. reported very recently that guanidinium thiocyanate promoted grain-boundary passivation increases the carrier lifetime of mixed Pb-Sn perovskites and achieved an (uncertified) PCE of 20.2% in narrow-bandgap solar cells, with a moderate $ J{\mathrm{sc}} $ value of $ \sim 30 \mathrm{mA} \mathrm{cm}^{-2} $ .

extraction_issues.quote: We further developed a recombination junction that avoids using sputtered indium-tin-oxide by taking the advantage of a robust and compact $ \mathrm{S n O}_{2} $ layer processed with atomic layer deposition. extraction_issues.reason: 右括号使用了全角 '）' 而非半角 ')'，属标点抽取错误，不影响理解。
